description.value: Boemma Euro Foods & Deli is a European specialty food shop and deli located on Burnaby's busy Kingsway corridor, stocking traditional imported European products alongside freshly made items from their in-house kitchen. The shop also offers catering services including charcuterie boards, meat platters, and custom orders. It's a distinctive provisioning stop for cyclists who appreciate specialty European ingredients and prepared deli goods.
